subject: Llama Model Family
claim: Current primary release series and weights
current_status: Llama 3.1 & 3.3 series available across 8B, 70B, and preview multimodal checkpoints under Meta Community License.

subject: Llama Commercial Threshold
claim: Monthly active user limit requiring additional enterprise license
current_status: Products with greater than 700 million monthly active users must request a special commercial license from Meta.

subject: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
claim: Specification creator and open standard status
current_status: Introduced by Anthropic in November 2024 as an open protocol. Adopted by Claude Desktop, Zed, Cursor, Antigravity, and community clients.

subject: MCP Transports
current_status: Supports local standard input/output (stdio) for local tools and Server-Sent Events (SSE) over HTTP for remote servers.

subject: Multi-Agent Frameworks
current_status: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Swarm support stateful supervisor loops, hierarchical agent handoffs, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
